metadata.description: Architecture for modular SwiftUI apps: feature-module Swift packages, domain-driven services and view models, and app-owned composition and navigation.

plugins.name: swiftui-architect
plugins.description: Architects modular SwiftUI apps as feature-module Swift packages, one per capability, over a shared package (Shared, SharedUI, SharedLive), DesignSystem and Networking, with domain-driven models and services, view models for loading and pagination, and an app target that composes screens, injects services and routes native SwiftUI navigation.
